course.title: 10TH Abhay Batch 2027
course.description:
1.We'll cover Science, Maths, Social Science, English (course A and B), Hindi  (Course A and B ), Sanskrit , IT , AI
2.Live lectures will be conducted, and in case you miss a session, recordings will be available to students in the Next Toppers app/website.
3.Classes will be scheduled according to your school timings.
4.There will be two classes per day, each lasting 1 hour 30 mins, timings will be shared in orientation session.
5.Every fifth class will be a dedicated doubt-solving session.
6.A weekly schedule will be provided for your convenience.
7.Class notes will be provided in PDF format after each class on the Next Toppers App/website.
8.Tests will be conducted to assess your progress.
9.⁠ ⁠Classes will commence on 1st December 2026 and the syllabus will be completed by mid January.
10.⁠ ⁠The entire course will remain accessible to you until your exams in 2027.
11.English, Hindi, Sanskrit and IT will be given recorded.
12.This course is non-transferable and non-refundable.
